$comment: Secret/leak rules for scripts/scan-secrets.mjs. Scoped tight to minimize false positives. Only source code (.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs) and .env* files are scanned; .md docs and the scanner's own files are skipped. See CLAUDE.md → Security review (pre-beta gate).

rules.description: Server-only secret given a VITE_ prefix — Vite bundles VITE_* into the browser. Server secrets must stay unprefixed.
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY referenced outside api/ — the service-role key must never reach client-bundled code.
Hardcoded JWT / Supabase key literal in source — keys belong in .env, read via env vars.
Hardcoded sk- style API key literal (OpenAI/Anthropic-style).
Hardcoded PayMongo secret key (sk_live_/sk_test_). Only the public key (pk_) is client-safe.
console logging a token/secret/key/password variable — risks leaking secrets to client devtools or server logs.
